p.hi: Touch down. The zero page. What is going on? Here? In town? You tell me. Here's some "news": False Liberty needs a practice place, preferrably one that is a low-rent pay-per-hour. If anyone knows of a place they could practice, in the northend Seattle or just Seattle area, please contact me, Verna, at 527-8834. Also, False Liberty is open to doing gigs around the state. Please contact Greg at 363-7485 or MG at the number above if you're doing a show or know someone who is and need(s) an inexpensive but excellant opening band. False Liberty will also be touring this summer. If you would like them to play in your town, call me at (206)527-8834 and we'll talk, OK.? Cool.
The Melvins' album should be out soon, if it's not out already.
Skin Yard' has an album out. Most local stores should have it. I know Fallout does.
